page: Microsoft Azure E48ads_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine powered by the AMD EPYC 7763 processor. Operating on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this server features 48 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 24 physical cores with multithreading enabled. The hardware configuration includes 384.0 GB of RAM, yielding an 8.0 GB memory-to-core ratio. Local storage is provided via a bundled 1843 GB disk, and the instance is capable of utilizing Premium Storage. No GPUs are included in this configuration.

Benchmark evaluations place the E48ads_v5 in the top 25% for multi-core and single-core CPU performance via stress-ng, as well as PassMark CPU and encryption tests. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and Geekbench ray tracing and image processing also register in the top tier. Memory bandwidth tests, including uncached large block reads at 94.97 GB/sec and writes at 45.98 GB/sec, perform in the middle 50% range. LLM inference speeds for text generation using a small 135M model show strong performance at 304.6 tokens/sec, while larger model processing remains average.

The qualitative value of the E48ads_v5 lies in its high memory density combined with dedicated AMD EPYC compute resources and substantial local storage. This resource balance makes it highly efficient for memory-intensive workloads without requiring separate storage allocations. Appropriate workloads include large-scale databases, memory-cached applications, enterprise resource planning systems, and data-intensive analytics pipelines.
description: Microsoft Azure E48ads_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine featuring 48 dedicated vCPUs and 24 physical cores powered by an AMD EPYC 7763 processor running at 3.525 GHz. It is equipped with 384.0 GB of RAM, providing an 8.0 GB memory-to-core ratio, and includes 1843 GB of local storage with Premium Storage capability. In benchmark testing, the server demonstrates strong multi-core CPU performance, high encryption throughput, and fast multi-threaded decompression, placing it in the top 25% of tested systems. Memory bandwidth and database operations perform in the average tier. This hardware profile offers high resource density for memory-heavy applications. The E48ads_v5 is designed for memory-intensive workloads, including large databases, enterprise applications, and data analytics.
